description: Knowledge graph gathered for an LLM context — a shared backbone in which resources AND annotations are typed nodes, connected by typed (optionally bidirectional) edges. Flattened views the matcher/generation read (connections, citedBy, siblings) are derived from these nodes/edges.

type.description: Edge kind: `annotation-of` (an annotation → the resource it lives on), `cites` (a citing linking annotation → the focal resource), or `link` (a resource → a resource it links to)

bidirectional.description: Whether the connection goes both ways. Absent on a `link` edge found through what cites a resource, which says nothing of the way back

truncated.description: Whether the graph stopped taking resources at its ceiling of 200 resource nodes, so that a resource within the depth asked for is not in it. Present, and true, only then
